## 🚀 Usage

Pin the major tag to follow every compatible release:

```yaml
uses: KostaD02/ci/.github/workflows/ci.yml@v1
```

Or pin this exact version:

```yaml
uses: KostaD02/ci/.github/workflows/ci.yml@v__VERSION__
```

## 📖 Docs

[README](https://github.com/KostaD02/ci#readme) lists every workflow and action, with
the caller files to copy.
